name: survivornet
description: Finds SurvivorNet articles and short expert videos that match the cancer topics in a ChatGPT conversation and shows them as a card carousel beneath the answer.

interface.longDescription:
SurvivorNet is a cancer news and education publisher. Its library covers diagnosis, screening, specific cancer types, treatments and drugs, side effects, clinical trials, survivorship, caregiving and coping, with short videos in which oncologists and survivors explain the topics.

When you ask ChatGPT about cancer, SurvivorNet finds the articles and expert videos that match what the answer covers and shows them as a card carousel beneath it. Articles open on survivornet.com; videos play inside the carousel.

Who it is for: people living with cancer, people facing screening or a new diagnosis, caregivers and family members, and anyone who wants trustworthy further reading on a cancer topic.

Limitations: SurvivorNet content is informational and educational and is not medical advice; decisions about care belong with your care team. SurvivorNet only recommends its own published content and returns nothing when no item is relevant enough. It does not access your ChatGPT history, health records or account, and needs no sign-in.
defaultPrompt: I was just diagnosed with HER2-positive breast cancer. What are my treatment options?
How can I manage nausea during chemotherapy?
My dad has stage 3 colon cancer. How can I support him as a caregiver?

positive.description: New diagnosis: treatment overview with matching resources
positive.prompt: I was just diagnosed with HER2-positive breast cancer. What are my treatment options?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT answers the question and calls the tool with queries such as 'HER2-positive breast cancer targeted therapy'. A carousel of SurvivorNet articles and expert videos on HER2-positive breast cancer treatment appears beneath the answer.

positive.prompt: How can I manage nausea during chemotherapy?
positive.expected_behavior: The answer is followed by a carousel with SurvivorNet articles and videos about chemotherapy-induced nausea. A video card plays inline when tapped.

positive.prompt: My dad has stage 3 colon cancer. How can I support him as a caregiver?
positive.expected_behavior: The carousel shows SurvivorNet content on colon cancer and on caregiving. Article cards open the article on survivornet.com.

positive.prompt: When should I start getting screened for prostate cancer, and what does a PSA test involve?
positive.expected_behavior: The carousel shows SurvivorNet content on prostate cancer screening and PSA testing.

positive.prompt: Can you find me some articles and videos about immunotherapy for lung cancer?
positive.expected_behavior: The carousel shows SurvivorNet articles and expert videos on immunotherapy for lung cancer, and the answer lists the article titles with links.

negative.description: Non-cancer health question: SurvivorNet covers cancer only, so the tool should not be called
negative.prompt: What's the best way to treat a sprained ankle?

negative.description: Unrelated task: no cancer topic in the conversation
negative.prompt: Help me write a polite email asking my landlord to fix the heating.

review.commerce_description: SurvivorNet does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: The recommendations view now declares its domain (https://mcp.survivornet.com) and is served under a new resource URI. No changes to the tool, the listing or availability.
